name: Tell customers where their job, order or matter is up to
summary: Tells customers where their job, order or matter is up to. Crons read job statuses in the business's job system, draft each customer message and queue it for approval; a person approves every message before it is sent. Unsuccessful jobs and clients with no usable contact go to a person.

all.evidence: 17 discovery calls tagged to this workflow; 6 read in full, 4 of those describe the process step by step

covered_by.record-keeping: check-status and daily-digest (store only, nothing written to the job)
covered_by.crew-or-supplier-check: gap (no crew or supplier progress in the mapped operations)

crons.name: check-status
crons.summary: Reads active jobs and records each change to Work Order or Completed. The first run only records a baseline.

crons.name: draft-updates
crons.summary: Drafts the customer message for each new change and queues the text or email for approval.

crons.name: daily-digest
crons.summary: Store only: counts by status, stale work orders and jobs a person must write (21:00 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. Every customer message is a live operation and waits in the approval queue for a person.

servicem8.covers: active job statuses, primary client contact, status text and email for Work Order and Completed

gaps: Tradify: help-centre pages returned HTTP 403, so the map rests on marketing pages, and the kit has no Tradify platform or operations. Its status sequence and any customer tracking page need a live account.

Crew and supplier progress: ServiceM8 shows staff status, navigation and arrival estimates in its app. The captured pages describe no API for live arrival time, and supplier progress is not covered. A person answers these.

Delay and arrival-time messages: the docs describe no delay template. The agent drafts the wording and it goes through approval. No automatic delay detection is built, because the scheduled-until field is not yet confirmed.
Quote acceptance: the captured pages do not say how a client approves a quote, so this workflow messages only on Work Order and Completed.
Freight, commercial leasing and legal process-serving matters: these calls describe matters ServiceM8 does not hold. They need their own platform adapters, which the kit does not have.
Overlap check: the business may already run ServiceM8 templates or automations that message clients. Check them before go-live so a client does not get two messages for one change.
Judgment steps: replies to where-is-my-job emails and calls, every Unsuccessful job, and any wording the owner has not approved. A person writes these.
Read limit: the cron reads what listJobs returns for active jobs and caps the list at 500.

evidence.calls: 17 calls tagged to this workflow; 6 read in full, 4 describe the process step by step, 0 rejected
evidence.platforms: ServiceM8 (help centre captured, 241 operations mapped in the kit) and Tradify (marketing pages only, not in the kit)
